title: unified-rollouts: add e2e tests + observability for canary/AB/shadow autorollback
author: Aisha Patel
description: Adds end-to-end integration tests and observability hooks for the unified rollouts autorollback flows (canary, A/B, and shadow modes). Motivation: recent incidents showed gaps in our end-to-end coverage for rollback triggers and left engineers without clear signal visibility during a gradual rollout. This PR introduces a deterministic test harness that can simulate degraded model quality, load patterns, and metric quorums so autorollback decisions and quarantine paths are exercised in CI. It also enhances logging/metrics to provide a per-rollout trace id and detailed rollback reason dimensions (metric, threshold, quorum, infra). Checklist: - [x] e2e test harness for canary + shadow + AB scenarios - [x] deterministic failure simulation helpers - [x] telemetry: rollout.trace_id, rollback.reason, rollback.metrics_snapshot - [x] integration with prometheus-exporter and tracing span tags - [x] unit tests for helpers - [x] CI job added to nightly/integration pipeline Related: ENG-9482 (autorollback telemetry), ENG-9510 (e2e test coverage).

release_notes: Added e2e coverage for unified rollouts autorollback (canary, A/B, shadow) and improved observability: rollout.trace_id and rollback.reason metrics/logs. Nightly integration job will exercise rollback paths and alert on regressions.
notes_for_oncall: On-call: use rollout.trace_id from alert details to pull the rollout timeline. If rollback.reason == 'metric_quorum' check metrics_snapshot in logs; if 'infra_timeout' check cluster provisioning events. Run the e2e harness locally (infra/tests/e2e) to reproduce scenarios.
testing_instructions: To run locally: 1) source dev-env; 2) python infra/tests/e2e/unified_rollouts_e2e_test.py --scenario canary --inject-failure degraded-quality; 3) tail logs for rollout.trace_id and verify rollback.reason and metrics_snapshot are emitted. CI job is configured at ci/pipelines/nightly-integration.yml.
